lastCompletedStory.title: Deterministic plan scope-proposal artifact (hand-rolled TS guard) emitted by planner and narrated

nextStoryContext: US-002 mirrors plan-verdict-report.ts exactly: src/supervisor/scope-proposal.ts exports ScopeProposal { problem, inScopeStories: string[], outOfScope: string[], framing: { mvp, launchReady } }, SCOPE_PROPOSAL_FILENAME = 'scripts/cam/scope-proposal.json' (ephemeral, gitignored, mirrors plan-verdict-report.json's own gitignore lines in both .gitignore and templates/.gitignore), and makeReadScopeProposal(cwd) (hand-rolled shape guard per ADR-0038, no zod). subagent-planner.md gained a '### Scope-Proposal Artifact' section (after the `type` field doc, before 'Target Issue Honoring') instructing the planner to write the artifact right after prd.json at plan completion; templates/agents/subagent-planner.md was cp'd byte-identical again (AC5 pattern precedent from US-001 continues here, though this story's AC5 only requires diff-equality for THIS specific pair, not a new blanket rule). plan-runner.ts wiring: RunPostAuditOptions gained an optional readScopeProposalFn dep; a new narrateScopeProposalIfComplete(planResult, readScopeProposalFn, notifyFn) helper folds BOTH the dep-presence guard and the `'report' in planResult` discriminator inside itself (runPostAuditAction was already at the biome 80-line ceiling, see the new patterns.md bullet on folding guards into extracted helpers) and is called unconditionally near the top of runPostAuditAction, narrating `[cam] plan scope: <problem> (in-scope: N, out-of-scope: N, MVP: <mvp>)` for any planResult carrying a PlanVerdictReport (audit-approved/audit-blocked/plan-escalated). Also extracted handleBlockedOrEscalated (shared audit-blocked/plan-escalated terminal body) to make room under the line ceiling. sidecar.ts wires makeReadScopeProposal(cwd) into runPostPlanActions's readScopeProposalFn, and makeClearStalePlanArtifacts now also removes a stale scope-proposal.json alongside plan-verdict-report.json/prd.json (functional completeness beyond the bare AC wording: a stale artifact from a prior cycle would otherwise re-narrate on an unrelated later planResult). Two file-size ceiling raises were needed (plan-runner.ts 1650->1711, sidecar.ts 3358->3369), both staged with a dated _ref note in scripts/file-size-budget.json before the gate re-run, per the story-owns-its-ceiling-raise convention (ADR-0022). No test file exists yet asserting sidecar.ts's readScopeProposalFn wiring or the notify narration string end-to-end (only plan-runner.ts's own unit-level behavior is exercised via the new scope-proposal.test.ts, which covers the reader in isolation); a future story wanting narration-string regression coverage would add a source-text wiring-oracle test on runPostPlanActions, mirroring the existing plan-target-invalid-sidecar.test.ts pattern noted in patterns.md.
